Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 6:10 AM, 09 November 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Atimonan, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Calauag, Lopez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Catanauan, Macalelon, General Luna, Gumaca, Pitogo, Unisan, Plaridel, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Buenavista, Mulanay, San Narciso, San Francisco, San Andres).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Batangas, Cavite, Metro Manila and Bulacan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Laguna, Rizal and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
